root_idea.summary: The root centers on persistent attachment or binding adherence, expressed in remaining committed to an oath or agreement.
root_idea.development: From the idea of adherence, the root develops meanings of sworn commitment, alliance and compact, and figurative clinging; the Quranic forms specifically attest oath-taking and habitual swearing.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form حَلَفَ.
Displayed as the Quranic intensive nominal حَلَّاف.

senses.definition: To swear or take an oath.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for oath-taking, including swearing by God or affirming, denying, or undertaking a matter. Perfect and imperfect Quranic forms represent the same lexical sense.
An intensive nominal describing one who swears repeatedly or often, rather than someone who has merely taken a single oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An alliance, confederacy, league, compact, or covenant between persons; by extension, sincere friendship founded on such attachment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relationship or agreement traditionally associated with mutual oaths.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A confederate, ally, or friend bound to another by a pledge of fidelity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a person joined to another in an alliance or loyal companionship.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To swear with another concerning a matter or undertaking; to swear mutually.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal oath-taking construction between two or more parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To unite in a confederacy, league, compact, or covenant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe an alliance for making the parties’ interests one, including mutual aid and defense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cling, adhere, or hold fast to something; figuratively, to remain attached to grief or sorrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative application extends attachment from a person or thing to an emotional state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The establishing of brotherhood between people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension of alliance-making to the creation of a bond of brotherhood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or require another to swear; to adjure or conjure someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative construction, including the language of requiring an oath before a judge or by God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a boy, to have nearly reached puberty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage is reported with disagreement about whether it denotes near attainment of puberty or the uncertainty that prompts people to swear about his status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the ḥalfāʾ grass, to reach maturity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical use, distinct from the puberty-related application.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the act or utterance of swearing an oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in, or producing, ḥalfāʾ grass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributive description of land characterized by this vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tall, coarse grass, especially the plant known as ḥalfāʾ, commonly growing near water or in valley bottoms.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is treated as a collective plant name in some grammatical analyses and also has singular and plural uses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A figurative epithet for a lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression alludes to the lion’s resort to places where ḥalfāʾ grass grows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clamorous female slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate lexical use from the plant name.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Anything that clings, adheres, or holds fast to another thing; figuratively, one persistently devoted to a quality or state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions such as one who is constant in generosity or sleeplessness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp-tongued, or chaste and eloquent in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression likening fluent or incisive speech to confederation with words.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sharp spearhead or spear with a sharp point.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation of sharpness, associated with the cutting points of ḥalfāʾ grass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A brisk, lively, or sprightly horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical interpretation of the same expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharpness in anything.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general abstract noun for the quality of being sharp.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A valley that produces ḥalfāʾ grass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nisbah-based description of a place associated with that plant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who swears, especially one who swears much or often.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active-participial description, less intensive in form than حَلَّاف.

other_classical_meanings.definition: How sharp-tongued or eloquent he is.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exclamatory expression praising incisive or refined speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person, animal, object, or circumstance whose uncertain status or quality causes people to swear about it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applications include a boy of doubtful puberty, stars said to occasion swearing, an animal of uncertain color or fatness, and anything else about which observers disagree.
